name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Cooper goes with Edmund or someone in the River Ward goes with Edmund (but not both).
Between Highrow and Riverside, one goes with Godfrey and the other with Rowan.
Rowan belongs to the Clothiers' Guild if and only if either Riverside goes with Potter or Beatrix goes with Mason (but not both).
Either Fletcher goes with Highrow or Wulfric goes with Bridgegate.
If either Riverside does not go with Beatrix or Edmund goes with Highrow (but not both), then Wulfric goes with Kingsford.
Beatrix, Rowan, and Oldwall go with Cooper, Fletcher, and Mason, in some order.

hints.text: Suppose Beatrix went with Blacksmith — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Beatrix goes with Blacksmith.
Beatrix goes with Blacksmith, so it can't also go with Cooper.
Beatrix goes with Blacksmith, so it can't also go with Fletcher.
Beatrix goes with Blacksmith, so it can't also go with Mason.
…but now the clue “Beatrix, Rowan, and Oldwall go with Cooper, Fletcher, and Mason, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Beatrix does not go with Blacksmith.
